    Asatru Legion¶

    [!INFO] The Ember Legion — Demons Who March in Order When Asatru marches, the Demon Continent has decided to be legible.

    History¶

    The standing military order of the Asatru Empire, the Legion is how the Demon Continent's oldest demon civilization translates itself to a world that expects 'demon' to mean horde. Founded in the settlement after Kirivis — the Demon King, founder-emperor — was betrayed and beheaded by Rulfred on the last day of the Demonic War (421 BGD) and his adopted children Maoth and Nethra carried his legacy through the Great Divergence, the Legion was reformed by General Doma after the succession civil war and hardened under Emperor Bionidas (Xiobita line) into its present form.

    It garrisons the Asatru Knight's Thorn peninsula in West Erisdar — treated not as colony but as integral imperial territory, the Demon Continent's permanent foothold on Erisdar — and holds the line in Kutten where Asatru influence rebuilt civilization after the Kutten Catastrophe that destroyed Elvengar. Between, it is the empire's voice in every treaty room where Demon Continent is invoked as abstraction and Asatru must make it concrete.

    Other demon nations — Maomodor Kingdom, Koebi Tribe, Cubra Tribe, Blazeyard, Emberalden — field their own fighters, but when foreign powers say "the demons will…" they mean this legion.

    Patron¶

    Kirivis-bin — the way of Kirivis — and through it, indirectly, Kirivis himself as remembered, not as shadow-caricature. The Legion's oath is sworn not to the emperor alone but to Kirivis's axiom: civilization is what you do when you could eat the other. Its chaplains are Kirivs-bin preceptors, its martyrology the 45-year march to save Goldenborn. Commanders keep a small ash-fleck from an Emberalden forge — a literal Demonic Ember — cold in a locket, warmed before battle by holding it over a flame: the coal remembers.

    Bionidas is the legal commander-in-chief; the Legion's heart believes its commander remains Kirivis.

    Sigil¶

    A black horned helm over a field of ash-gray, crossed by a vertical ember-red stripe — the Ember Line — representing the surviving fire after the ash. On campaign in West Erisdar the helm is rendered in off-white bone to distinguish from Demon's Horn's own civic flag, with which it is deliberately confused by merchants for prestige. Veteran legions add a small silver ring at the helm's crown for The Silver Bride — demons, like everyone else, march under the same ring.

    Role¶

    Expeditionary heavy infantry, demon-line shock, and intercontinental enforcement. The Legion fields disciplined blocks that mix Xiobita and Bjor Demons with allied Koebi spear, Kutra scouts, and Malgardian auxiliaries. Its special competence is holding a treaty line: it will not advance a foot beyond what the map allows, which makes it the most trustworthy — and most frustrating — force to negotiate against.

    In West Erisdar it secures Knight's Thorn against Palonia and Direfirth pressure, escorts commerce through the Demonic Sea to Demon's Horn, and enforces Demonic Ember acceptance at ports where merchants would rather price in West Erisdarian Guilder.

    Relation to Currencies & Regions¶

    The Legion is the enforcement behind the Demonic Ember — warm iron flecked with Emberalden ash, backed by forge-heat and legion discipline. In Demon's Horn and Yakut Territory (Kutten colony), the Ember is legal tender because the Legion will collect it. Outside demon territory the Legion's pay-chest carries West Erisdarian Guilder for West Erisdar transactions and Vennerian Ducat for sea movement; its factors maintain a standing exchange with Dwarvengor assay offices that weight Silver Talon honestly enough to trust.

    At Demon's Horn, the Legion's presence makes Ember-to-Ducat conversion the day's first price — the honest one.
